concerns.location: tasks.md:## Phase 3 – Model training & performance validation (US 2)
concerns.text: User‑Story 2 tasks (T017‑T021) depend on the dataset produced in US 1 (final_dataset.parquet). This makes US 2 not independently shippable, violating the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule for each US block.

Tasks T003‑T008 are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but they all write to shared filesystem locations (e.g., creating the same directories, writing to the same `requirements.txt`). Parallel execution could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
